notes: Both builds passed. Base B because it encodes the page's separate 5-day (woman) and 3-day (man) windows; A used 5 days for everyone. Both agree on pregnancy, traumatic injury, suicidal thoughts, planning suicide and overdose. The main open point is whether the 'Suspect sexual assault/rape' lines should be possible diagnosis rules (A) or only definitions of the complaint (B); it is marked unsettled and asked in remaining-questions. B's sex branches only fire if sex is recorded as a Female/Male finding.
